name: color_of_object
description: Name the typical color of a common object (banana -> yellow). Control copies the object noun from the same frame.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
P=[('banana','yellow'),('lemon','yellow'),('grass','green'),('lime','green'),('sky','blue'),('ocean','blue'),('snow','white'),('milk','white'),('coal','black'),('crow','black'),('tomato','red'),('strawberry','red'),('blood','red'),('carrot','orange'),('pumpkin','orange'),('chocolate','brown'),('eggplant','purple'),('flamingo','pink'),('cucumber','green'),('cherry','red'),('sunflower','yellow'),('raven','black'),('frog','green'),('cloud','white'),('ash','gray'),('elephant','gray'),('grape','purple'),('coffee','brown'),('emerald','green'),('sapphire','blue'),('ruby','red'),('pearl','white')]
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(96):
    o,c=P[i%len(P)]
    fr=random.choice(['Answer with one word.','Short answer.','Quiz.'])
    items.append({"prompt":f"{fr} The usual color of a {o} is","answer":" "+c})
    control.append({"prompt":f"{fr} The usual color of a {o}. The object named here is a","answer":" "+o})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
